brief: A meeting scheduler where time flows as a river — free slots are calm water, meetings are bridges

dominant_strengths: Strong conceptual metaphor: bridges over water reads instantly and gives the scheduler poetic identity beyond a generic timeline
Cohesive blue palette with warm wooden bridge accents creates believable river atmosphere and clear figure/ground separation
dominant_weaknesses: Bridges are flat rounded rectangles with no plank texture, rope, or shadow — metaphor is told in copy, not rendered in craft
Typography is generic system bold; meeting labels float centered without time ranges, attendees, or hierarchy beyond title
Empty 'calm water' slots show no ripple, current, or affordance for clicking — the river feels static rather than flowing
fix_priorities: Render bridges with actual structure (planks, pylons, cast shadows on water) so the metaphor is visual not verbal
Add subtle animated water (caustics, drifting highlights) and ripple-on-hover to make free slots feel alive and clickable
Strengthen meeting cards with start–end times, duration, and participants to restore behavioral utility
Refine typography with a more editorial display face for the title and tabular numerals for the time column
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral concept lands, but behavioral information density is thin and reflective payoff stalls because the metaphor isn't carried into texture or motion.
rationale.intent_fit: It gestures at the river-and-bridges brief verbally and chromatically, but the execution stops at colored bars labeled 'bridge' rather than truly embodying the metaphor.
